verdict.rationale: Controlling context memory allocation is a fair question for a local inference runtime, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers context-size settings, KV-cache or memory allocation, or running multiple model instances concurrently. Distributed GPU worker nodes and automatic GPU detection are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
